items.title: Blindfolded Beanie Baby Walk – The First Thirty Programs
items.summary: The Blindfolded Beanie Baby Walk has become one of our most popular Education By Entertainment Mind Games activities. I’m pleased to be sharing a cumulative photo album from the first thirty events which included this activity with photos we can share.  (There have been several additional events without photos or with photos we cannot share online.)  The events have been offered for businesses, conferences, expos, fairs, libraries, schools (grade 3 and up) and youth groups. For this activity our contestants:•Are securely blindfolded•Select a support team to load then with beanies•Are loaded with as many Beanie Babies as they can carry•Walk around the venue shaking hands with at least six guests trying not to drop any.•Receive one point for each beanie carried to completion minus two points for each beanie baby droppedAs of this posting the records for contestants wearing their own clothes are:o125 beanies loadedo120 beanies carried to completiono110 points (120 for each carried to completion minus two for each one dropped) One contestant borrowed an oversized hoodie and carried 125 beanies to completion with none dropped.
